import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.MSSMNu.LineY3B3
/-!
# The type of solutions perpendicular to `Y₃` and `B₃`

We define the type of solutions which are orthogonal to `Y₃` and `B₃` and prove some basic lemmas
about them.

# References

The main reference for the material in this file is:

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2107.07926.pdf

-/
universe v u

namespace MSSMACC
open MSSMCharges
open MSSMACCs
open BigOperators

/-- The type of linear solutions orthogonal to $Y_3$ and $B_3$. -/
structure AnomalyFreePerp extends MSSMACC.LinSols where
  perpY₃ : dot Y₃.val val = 0
  perpB₃ : dot B₃.val val = 0

/-- The projection of an object in `MSSMACC.AnomalyFreeLinear` onto the subspace
  orthogonal to `Y₃` and`B₃`. -/
def proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) : MSSMACC.AnomalyFreePerp :=
  ⟨(dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) • Y₃.1.1
  + (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) • B₃.1.1
  + dot Y₃.val B₃.val • T,
  by
    change dot _ (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val + _ • T.val) = 0
    rw [dot.map_add₂, dot.map_add₂]
    rw [dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val Y₃.val = 216 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    ring,
  by
    change dot _ (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val + _ • T.val) = 0
    rw [dot.map_add₂, dot.map_add₂]
    rw [dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot B₃.val Y₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot B₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    ring⟩

lemma proj_val (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    (proj T).val = (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) • Y₃.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) • B₃.val +
    dot Y₃.val B₃.val • T.val := by
  rfl

lemma Y₃_plus_B₃_plus_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) (a b c : ℚ) :
    a • Y₃.val + b • B₃.val + c • (proj T).val =
    (a + c * (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val)) • Y₃.val
    + (b + c * (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val)) • B₃.val
    + (dot Y₃.val B₃.val * c) • T.val:= by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [DistribMulAction.smul_add, DistribMulAction.smul_add]
  rw [add_assoc (_ • _ • Y₃.val), ← add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val), add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val)]
  rw [add_comm (_ • B₃.val) (_ • _ • Y₃.val), ← add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val)]
  rw [← MulAction.mul_smul, ← Module.add_smul]
  repeat rw [add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [← add_assoc, ← MulAction.mul_smul, ← Module.add_smul]
  apply congrArg
  simp only [HSMul.hSMul, SMul.smul, MSSMACC_numberCharges, Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceFinMk]
  funext i
  linarith

lemma quad_Y₃_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    quadBiLin Y₃.val (proj T).val = dot Y₃.val B₃.val * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [show quadBiLin Y₃.val B₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  rw [show quadBiLin Y₃.val Y₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  ring

lemma quad_B₃_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    quadBiLin B₃.val (proj T).val = dot Y₃.val B₃.val * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [show quadBiLin B₃.val Y₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  rw [show quadBiLin B₃.val B₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  ring

lemma quad_self_proj (T : MSSMACC.Sols) :
    quadBiLin T.val (proj T.1.1).val =
    (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  erw [quadSol T.1]
  rw [quadBiLin.swap T.val Y₃.val, quadBiLin.swap T.val B₃.val]
  ring

lemma quad_proj (T : MSSMACC.Sols) :
    quadBiLin (proj T.1.1).val (proj T.1.1).val = 2 * dot Y₃.val B₃.val *
    ((dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val) := by
  nth_rewrite 1 [proj_val]
  repeat rw [quadBiLin.map_add₁]
  repeat rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₁]
  rw [quad_Y₃_proj, quad_B₃_proj, quad_self_proj]
  ring

lemma cube_proj_proj_Y₃ (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    cubeTriLin (proj T).val (proj T).val Y₃.val =
    (dot Y₃.val B₃.val)^2 * cubeTriLin T.val T.val Y₃.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₁, cubeTriLin.map_add₂]
  erw [lineY₃B₃_doublePoint]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.swap₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₃]
  rw [doublePoint_Y₃_Y₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₃, cubeTriLin.swap₁]
  rw [doublePoint_Y₃_B₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.swap₁, cubeTriLin.swap₂]
  rw [doublePoint_Y₃_Y₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.swap₁, cubeTriLin.swap₂, cubeTriLin.swap₁]
  rw [doublePoint_Y₃_B₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₂]
  ring

lemma cube_proj_proj_B₃ (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    cubeTriLin (proj T).val (proj T).val B₃.val =
    (dot Y₃.val B₃.val)^2 * cubeTriLin T.val T.val B₃.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₁, cubeTriLin.map_add₂]
  erw [lineY₃B₃_doublePoint]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₂, cubeTriLin.swap₂, cubeTriLin.map_add₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₁,
    cubeTriLin.map_smul₃, doublePoint_Y₃_B₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₃, cubeTriLin.swap₁, doublePoint_B₃_B₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₂, cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.swap₁, cubeTriLin.swap₂, doublePoint_Y₃_B₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₂, cubeTriLin.swap₁, cubeTriLin.swap₂,
    cubeTriLin.swap₁, doublePoint_B₃_B₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₂]
  ring

lemma cube_proj_proj_self (T : MSSMACC.Sols) :
    cubeTriLin (proj T.1.1).val (proj T.1.1).val T.val =
    2 * dot Y₃.val B₃.val *
    ((dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) * cubeTriLin T.val T.val Y₃.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) * cubeTriLin T.val T.val B₃.val) := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₁, cubeTriLin.map_add₂]
  erw [lineY₃B₃_doublePoint]
  repeat rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₁]
  repeat rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁]
  repeat rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₂]
  repeat rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₂]
  erw [T.cubicSol]
  rw [cubeTriLin.swap₁ Y₃.val T.val T.val, cubeTriLin.swap₂ T.val Y₃.val T.val]
  rw [cubeTriLin.swap₁ B₃.val T.val T.val, cubeTriLin.swap₂ T.val B₃.val T.val]
  ring

lemma cube_proj (T : MSSMACC.Sols) :
    cubeTriLin (proj T.1.1).val (proj T.1.1).val (proj T.1.1).val =
    3 * dot Y₃.val B₃.val ^ 2 *
    ((dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) * cubeTriLin T.val T.val Y₃.val +
        (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) * cubeTriLin T.val T.val B₃.val) := by
  exact?

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.MSSMNu.LineY3B3
/-!
# The type of solutions perpendicular to `Y₃` and `B₃`

We define the type of solutions which are orthogonal to `Y₃` and `B₃` and prove some basic lemmas
about them.

# References

The main reference for the material in this file is:

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2107.07926.pdf

-/
universe v u

namespace MSSMACC
open MSSMCharges
open MSSMACCs
open BigOperators

/-- The type of linear solutions orthogonal to $Y_3$ and $B_3$. -/
structure AnomalyFreePerp extends MSSMACC.LinSols where
  perpY₃ : dot Y₃.val val = 0
  perpB₃ : dot B₃.val val = 0

/-- The projection of an object in `MSSMACC.AnomalyFreeLinear` onto the subspace
  orthogonal to `Y₃` and`B₃`. -/
def proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) : MSSMACC.AnomalyFreePerp :=
  ⟨(dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) • Y₃.1.1
  + (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) • B₃.1.1
  + dot Y₃.val B₃.val • T,
  by
    change dot _ (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val + _ • T.val) = 0
    rw [dot.map_add₂, dot.map_add₂]
    rw [dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val Y₃.val = 216 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    ring,
  by
    change dot _ (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val + _ • T.val) = 0
    rw [dot.map_add₂, dot.map_add₂]
    rw [dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot B₃.val Y₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot B₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    ring⟩

lemma proj_val (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    (proj T).val = (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) • Y₃.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) • B₃.val +
    dot Y₃.val B₃.val • T.val := by
  rfl

lemma Y₃_plus_B₃_plus_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) (a b c : ℚ) :
    a • Y₃.val + b • B₃.val + c • (proj T).val =
    (a + c * (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val)) • Y₃.val
    + (b + c * (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val)) • B₃.val
    + (dot Y₃.val B₃.val * c) • T.val:= by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [DistribMulAction.smul_add, DistribMulAction.smul_add]
  rw [add_assoc (_ • _ • Y₃.val), ← add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val), add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val)]
  rw [add_comm (_ • B₃.val) (_ • _ • Y₃.val), ← add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val)]
  rw [← MulAction.mul_smul, ← Module.add_smul]
  repeat rw [add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [← add_assoc, ← MulAction.mul_smul, ← Module.add_smul]
  apply congrArg
  simp only [HSMul.hSMul, SMul.smul, MSSMACC_numberCharges, Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceFinMk]
  funext i
  linarith

lemma quad_Y₃_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    quadBiLin Y₃.val (proj T).val = dot Y₃.val B₃.val * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [show quadBiLin Y₃.val B₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  rw [show quadBiLin Y₃.val Y₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  ring

lemma quad_B₃_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    quadBiLin B₃.val (proj T).val = dot Y₃.val B₃.val * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [show quadBiLin B₃.val Y₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  rw [show quadBiLin B₃.val B₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  ring

lemma quad_self_proj (T : MSSMACC.Sols) :
    quadBiLin T.val (proj T.1.1).val =
    (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  erw [quadSol T.1]
  rw [quadBiLin.swap T.val Y₃.val, quadBiLin.swap T.val B₃.val]
  ring

lemma quad_proj (T : MSSMACC.Sols) :
    quadBiLin (proj T.1.1).val (proj T.1.1).val = 2 * dot Y₃.val B₃.val *
    ((dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val) := by
  nth_rewrite 1 [proj_val]
  repeat rw [quadBiLin.map_add₁]
  repeat rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₁]
  rw [quad_Y₃_proj, quad_B₃_proj, quad_self_proj]
  ring

lemma cube_proj_proj_Y₃ (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    cubeTriLin (proj T).val (proj T).val Y₃.val =
    (dot Y₃.val B₃.val)^2 * cubeTriLin T.val T.val Y₃.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₁, cubeTriLin.map_add₂]
  erw [lineY₃B₃_doublePoint]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.swap₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₃]
  rw [doublePoint_Y₃_Y₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₃, cubeTriLin.swap₁]
  rw [doublePoint_Y₃_B₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.swap₁, cubeTriLin.swap₂]
  rw [doublePoint_Y₃_Y₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.swap₁, cubeTriLin.swap₂, cubeTriLin.swap₁]
  rw [doublePoint_Y₃_B₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₂]
  ring

lemma cube_proj_proj_B₃ (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    cubeTriLin (proj T).val (proj T).val B₃.val =
    (dot Y₃.val B₃.val)^2 * cubeTriLin T.val T.val B₃.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₁, cubeTriLin.map_add₂]
  erw [lineY₃B₃_doublePoint]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₂, cubeTriLin.swap₂, cubeTriLin.map_add₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₁,
    cubeTriLin.map_smul₃, doublePoint_Y₃_B₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₃, cubeTriLin.swap₁, doublePoint_B₃_B₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₂, cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.swap₁, cubeTriLin.swap₂, doublePoint_Y₃_B₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₂, cubeTriLin.swap₁, cubeTriLin.swap₂,
    cubeTriLin.swap₁, doublePoint_B₃_B₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₂]
  ring

lemma cube_proj_proj_self (T : MSSMACC.Sols) :
    cubeTriLin (proj T.1.1).val (proj T.1.1).val T.val =
    2 * dot Y₃.val B₃.val *
    ((dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) * cubeTriLin T.val T.val Y₃.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) * cubeTriLin T.val T.val B₃.val) := by
  exact?

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.MSSMNu.LineY3B3
/-!
# The type of solutions perpendicular to `Y₃` and `B₃`

We define the type of solutions which are orthogonal to `Y₃` and `B₃` and prove some basic lemmas
about them.

# References

The main reference for the material in this file is:

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2107.07926.pdf

-/
universe v u

namespace MSSMACC
open MSSMCharges
open MSSMACCs
open BigOperators

/-- The type of linear solutions orthogonal to $Y_3$ and $B_3$. -/
structure AnomalyFreePerp extends MSSMACC.LinSols where
  perpY₃ : dot Y₃.val val = 0
  perpB₃ : dot B₃.val val = 0

/-- The projection of an object in `MSSMACC.AnomalyFreeLinear` onto the subspace
  orthogonal to `Y₃` and`B₃`. -/
def proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) : MSSMACC.AnomalyFreePerp :=
  ⟨(dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) • Y₃.1.1
  + (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) • B₃.1.1
  + dot Y₃.val B₃.val • T,
  by
    change dot _ (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val + _ • T.val) = 0
    rw [dot.map_add₂, dot.map_add₂]
    rw [dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val Y₃.val = 216 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    ring,
  by
    change dot _ (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val + _ • T.val) = 0
    rw [dot.map_add₂, dot.map_add₂]
    rw [dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot B₃.val Y₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot B₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    ring⟩

lemma proj_val (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    (proj T).val = (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) • Y₃.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) • B₃.val +
    dot Y₃.val B₃.val • T.val := by
  rfl

lemma Y₃_plus_B₃_plus_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) (a b c : ℚ) :
    a • Y₃.val + b • B₃.val + c • (proj T).val =
    (a + c * (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val)) • Y₃.val
    + (b + c * (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val)) • B₃.val
    + (dot Y₃.val B₃.val * c) • T.val:= by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [DistribMulAction.smul_add, DistribMulAction.smul_add]
  rw [add_assoc (_ • _ • Y₃.val), ← add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val), add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val)]
  rw [add_comm (_ • B₃.val) (_ • _ • Y₃.val), ← add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val)]
  rw [← MulAction.mul_smul, ← Module.add_smul]
  repeat rw [add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [← add_assoc, ← MulAction.mul_smul, ← Module.add_smul]
  apply congrArg
  simp only [HSMul.hSMul, SMul.smul, MSSMACC_numberCharges, Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceFinMk]
  funext i
  linarith

lemma quad_Y₃_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    quadBiLin Y₃.val (proj T).val = dot Y₃.val B₃.val * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [show quadBiLin Y₃.val B₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  rw [show quadBiLin Y₃.val Y₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  ring

lemma quad_B₃_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    quadBiLin B₃.val (proj T).val = dot Y₃.val B₃.val * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [show quadBiLin B₃.val Y₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  rw [show quadBiLin B₃.val B₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  ring

lemma quad_self_proj (T : MSSMACC.Sols) :
    quadBiLin T.val (proj T.1.1).val =
    (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  erw [quadSol T.1]
  rw [quadBiLin.swap T.val Y₃.val, quadBiLin.swap T.val B₃.val]
  ring

lemma quad_proj (T : MSSMACC.Sols) :
    quadBiLin (proj T.1.1).val (proj T.1.1).val = 2 * dot Y₃.val B₃.val *
    ((dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val) := by
  nth_rewrite 1 [proj_val]
  repeat rw [quadBiLin.map_add₁]
  repeat rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₁]
  rw [quad_Y₃_proj, quad_B₃_proj, quad_self_proj]
  ring

lemma cube_proj_proj_Y₃ (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    cubeTriLin (proj T).val (proj T).val Y₃.val =
    (dot Y₃.val B₃.val)^2 * cubeTriLin T.val T.val Y₃.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₁, cubeTriLin.map_add₂]
  erw [lineY₃B₃_doublePoint]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.swap₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₃]
  rw [doublePoint_Y₃_Y₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₃, cubeTriLin.swap₁]
  rw [doublePoint_Y₃_B₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.swap₁, cubeTriLin.swap₂]
  rw [doublePoint_Y₃_Y₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.swap₁, cubeTriLin.swap₂, cubeTriLin.swap₁]
  rw [doublePoint_Y₃_B₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₂]
  ring

lemma cube_proj_proj_B₃ (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    cubeTriLin (proj T).val (proj T).val B₃.val =
    (dot Y₃.val B₃.val)^2 * cubeTriLin T.val T.val B₃.val := by
  exact?

/-- The projection of an object in `MSSMACC.AnomalyFreeLinear` onto the subspace
  orthogonal to `Y₃` and`B₃`. -/
def proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) : MSSMACC.AnomalyFreePerp :=
  ⟨(dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) • Y₃.1.1
  + (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) • B₃.1.1
  + dot Y₃.val B₃.val • T,
  by
    change dot _ (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val + _ • T.val) = 0

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.MSSMNu.LineY3B3
/-!
# The type of solutions perpendicular to `Y₃` and `B₃`

We define the type of solutions which are orthogonal to `Y₃` and `B₃` and prove some basic lemmas
about them.

# References

The main reference for the material in this file is:

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2107.07926.pdf

-/
universe v u

namespace MSSMACC
open MSSMCharges
open MSSMACCs
open BigOperators

/-- The type of linear solutions orthogonal to $Y_3$ and $B_3$. -/
structure AnomalyFreePerp extends MSSMACC.LinSols where
  perpY₃ : dot Y₃.val val = 0
  perpB₃ : dot B₃.val val = 0

/-- The projection of an object in `MSSMACC.AnomalyFreeLinear` onto the subspace
  orthogonal to `Y₃` and`B₃`. -/
def proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) : MSSMACC.AnomalyFreePerp :=
  ⟨(dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) • Y₃.1.1
  + (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) • B₃.1.1
  + dot Y₃.val B₃.val • T,
  by
    change dot _ (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val + _ • T.val) = 0
    rw [dot.map_add₂, dot.map_add₂]
    rw [dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val Y₃.val = 216 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    ring,
  by
    change dot _ (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val + _ • T.val) = 0
    rw [dot.map_add₂, dot.map_add₂]
    rw [dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot B₃.val Y₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot B₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    ring⟩

lemma proj_val (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    (proj T).val = (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) • Y₃.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) • B₃.val +
    dot Y₃.val B₃.val • T.val := by
  rfl

lemma Y₃_plus_B₃_plus_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) (a b c : ℚ) :
    a • Y₃.val + b • B₃.val + c • (proj T).val =
    (a + c * (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val)) • Y₃.val
    + (b + c * (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val)) • B₃.val
    + (dot Y₃.val B₃.val * c) • T.val:= by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [DistribMulAction.smul_add, DistribMulAction.smul_add]
  rw [add_assoc (_ • _ • Y₃.val), ← add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val), add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val)]
  rw [add_comm (_ • B₃.val) (_ • _ • Y₃.val), ← add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val)]
  rw [← MulAction.mul_smul, ← Module.add_smul]
  repeat rw [add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [← add_assoc, ← MulAction.mul_smul, ← Module.add_smul]
  apply congrArg
  simp only [HSMul.hSMul, SMul.smul, MSSMACC_numberCharges, Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceFinMk]
  funext i
  linarith

lemma quad_Y₃_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    quadBiLin Y₃.val (proj T).val = dot Y₃.val B₃.val * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [show quadBiLin Y₃.val B₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  rw [show quadBiLin Y₃.val Y₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  ring

lemma quad_B₃_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    quadBiLin B₃.val (proj T).val = dot Y₃.val B₃.val * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [show quadBiLin B₃.val Y₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  rw [show quadBiLin B₃.val B₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  ring

lemma quad_self_proj (T : MSSMACC.Sols) :
    quadBiLin T.val (proj T.1.1).val =
    (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  erw [quadSol T.1]
  rw [quadBiLin.swap T.val Y₃.val, quadBiLin.swap T.val B₃.val]
  ring

lemma quad_proj (T : MSSMACC.Sols) :
    quadBiLin (proj T.1.1).val (proj T.1.1).val = 2 * dot Y₃.val B₃.val *
    ((dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val) := by
  nth_rewrite 1 [proj_val]
  repeat rw [quadBiLin.map_add₁]
  repeat rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₁]

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.MSSMNu.LineY3B3
/-!
# The type of solutions perpendicular to `Y₃` and `B₃`

We define the type of solutions which are orthogonal to `Y₃` and `B₃` and prove some basic lemmas
about them.

# References

The main reference for the material in this file is:

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2107.07926.pdf

-/
universe v u

namespace MSSMACC
open MSSMCharges
open MSSMACCs
open BigOperators

/-- The type of linear solutions orthogonal to $Y_3$ and $B_3$. -/
structure AnomalyFreePerp extends MSSMACC.LinSols where
  perpY₃ : dot Y₃.val val = 0
  perpB₃ : dot B₃.val val = 0

/-- The projection of an object in `MSSMACC.AnomalyFreeLinear` onto the subspace
  orthogonal to `Y₃` and`B₃`. -/
def proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) : MSSMACC.AnomalyFreePerp :=
  ⟨(dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) • Y₃.1.1
  + (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) • B₃.1.1
  + dot Y₃.val B₃.val • T,
  by
    change dot _ (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val + _ • T.val) = 0
    rw [dot.map_add₂, dot.map_add₂]
    rw [dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val Y₃.val = 216 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    ring,
  by
    change dot _ (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val + _ • T.val) = 0
    rw [dot.map_add₂, dot.map_add₂]
    rw [dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot B₃.val Y₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot B₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    ring⟩

lemma proj_val (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    (proj T).val = (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) • Y₃.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) • B₃.val +
    dot Y₃.val B₃.val • T.val := by
  rfl

lemma Y₃_plus_B₃_plus_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) (a b c : ℚ) :
    a • Y₃.val + b • B₃.val + c • (proj T).val =
    (a + c * (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val)) • Y₃.val
    + (b + c * (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val)) • B₃.val
    + (dot Y₃.val B₃.val * c) • T.val:= by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [DistribMulAction.smul_add, DistribMulAction.smul_add]
  rw [add_assoc (_ • _ • Y₃.val), ← add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val), add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val)]
  rw [add_comm (_ • B₃.val) (_ • _ • Y₃.val), ← add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val)]
  rw [← MulAction.mul_smul, ← Module.add_smul]
  repeat rw [add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [← add_assoc, ← MulAction.mul_smul, ← Module.add_smul]
  apply congrArg
  simp only [HSMul.hSMul, SMul.smul, MSSMACC_numberCharges, Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceFinMk]
  funext i
  linarith

lemma quad_Y₃_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    quadBiLin Y₃.val (proj T).val = dot Y₃.val B₃.val * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [show quadBiLin Y₃.val B₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  rw [show quadBiLin Y₃.val Y₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  ring

lemma quad_B₃_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    quadBiLin B₃.val (proj T).val = dot Y₃.val B₃.val * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [show quadBiLin B₃.val Y₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  rw [show quadBiLin B₃.val B₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  ring

lemma quad_self_proj (T : MSSMACC.Sols) :
    quadBiLin T.val (proj T.1.1).val =
    (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  erw [quadSol T.1]
  rw [quadBiLin.swap T.val Y₃.val, quadBiLin.swap T.val B₃.val]
  ring

lemma quad_proj (T : MSSMACC.Sols) :
    quadBiLin (proj T.1.1).val (proj T.1.1).val = 2 * dot Y₃.val B₃.val *
    ((dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val) := by
  nth_rewrite 1 [proj_val]
  repeat rw [quadBiLin.map_add₁]
  repeat rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₁]
  rw [quad_Y₃_proj, quad_B₃_proj, quad_self_proj]
  ring

lemma cube_proj_proj_Y₃ (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    cubeTriLin (proj T).val (proj T).val Y₃.val =
    (dot Y₃.val B₃.val)^2 * cubeTriLin T.val T.val Y₃.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₁, cubeTriLin.map_add₂]
  erw [lineY₃B₃_doublePoint]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.swap₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₃]
  rw [doublePoint_Y₃_Y₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₃, cubeTriLin.swap₁]
  rw [doublePoint_Y₃_B₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_add₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.swap₁, cubeTriLin.swap₂]
  rw [doublePoint_Y₃_Y₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [cubeTriLin.swap₁, cubeTriLin.swap₂, cubeTriLin.swap₁]
  rw [doublePoint_Y₃_B₃]
  rw [cubeTriLin.map_smul₁, cubeTriLin.map_smul₂]
  ring

@[simps!]
def dot : BiLinearSymm MSSMCharges.Charges := BiLinearSymm.mk₂
  (fun S => ∑ i, (Q S.1 i * Q S.2 i + U S.1 i * U S.2 i +
    D S.1 i * D S.2 i + L S.1 i * L S.2 i + E S.1 i * E S.2 i
    + N S.1 i * N S.2 i) + Hd S.1 * Hd S.2 + Hu S.1 * Hu S.2)
  (by
    intro a S T
    simp only [MSSMSpecies_numberCharges]
    repeat rw [(toSMSpecies _).map_smul]
    rw [Hd.map_smul, Hu.map_smul]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [HSMul.hSMul, SMul.smul, Fin.isValue, toSMSpecies_apply, Hd_apply, Fin.reduceFinMk,
      Hu_apply]
    ring)
  (by
    intro S1 S2 T
    simp only [MSSMSpecies_numberCharges, toSMSpecies_apply, Fin.isValue,
      ACCSystemCharges.chargesAddCommMonoid_add, map_add, Hd_apply, Fin.reduceFinMk, Hu_apply]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [reduceMul, Fin.isValue, Prod.mk_zero_zero, Prod.mk_one_one]
    ring)
  (by
    intro S T
    simp only [MSSMSpecies_numberCharges, toSMSpecies_apply, Fin.isValue, Hd_apply, Fin.reduceFinMk,
      Hu_apply]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [reduceMul, Fin.isValue, Prod.mk_zero_zero, Prod.mk_one_one]
    ring)

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.MSSMNu.LineY3B3
/-!
# The type of solutions perpendicular to `Y₃` and `B₃`

We define the type of solutions which are orthogonal to `Y₃` and `B₃` and prove some basic lemmas
about them.

# References

The main reference for the material in this file is:

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2107.07926.pdf

-/
universe v u

namespace MSSMACC
open MSSMCharges
open MSSMACCs
open BigOperators

/-- The type of linear solutions orthogonal to $Y_3$ and $B_3$. -/
structure AnomalyFreePerp extends MSSMACC.LinSols where
  perpY₃ : dot Y₃.val val = 0
  perpB₃ : dot B₃.val val = 0

/-- The projection of an object in `MSSMACC.AnomalyFreeLinear` onto the subspace
  orthogonal to `Y₃` and`B₃`. -/
def proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) : MSSMACC.AnomalyFreePerp :=
  ⟨(dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) • Y₃.1.1
  + (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) • B₃.1.1
  + dot Y₃.val B₃.val • T,
  by
    change dot _ (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val + _ • T.val) = 0
    rw [dot.map_add₂, dot.map_add₂]
    rw [dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val Y₃.val = 216 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    ring,
  by
    change dot _ (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val + _ • T.val) = 0
    rw [dot.map_add₂, dot.map_add₂]
    rw [dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot B₃.val Y₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot B₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    ring⟩

lemma proj_val (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    (proj T).val = (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) • Y₃.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) • B₃.val +
    dot Y₃.val B₃.val • T.val := by
  rfl

lemma Y₃_plus_B₃_plus_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) (a b c : ℚ) :
    a • Y₃.val + b • B₃.val + c • (proj T).val =
    (a + c * (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val)) • Y₃.val
    + (b + c * (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val)) • B₃.val
    + (dot Y₃.val B₃.val * c) • T.val:= by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [DistribMulAction.smul_add, DistribMulAction.smul_add]
  rw [add_assoc (_ • _ • Y₃.val), ← add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val), add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val)]
  rw [add_comm (_ • B₃.val) (_ • _ • Y₃.val), ← add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val)]
  rw [← MulAction.mul_smul, ← Module.add_smul]
  repeat rw [add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [← add_assoc, ← MulAction.mul_smul, ← Module.add_smul]
  apply congrArg
  simp only [HSMul.hSMul, SMul.smul, MSSMACC_numberCharges, Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceFinMk]
  funext i
  linarith

lemma quad_Y₃_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    quadBiLin Y₃.val (proj T).val = dot Y₃.val B₃.val * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [show quadBiLin Y₃.val B₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  rw [show quadBiLin Y₃.val Y₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  ring

lemma quad_B₃_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    quadBiLin B₃.val (proj T).val = dot Y₃.val B₃.val * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [show quadBiLin B₃.val Y₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  rw [show quadBiLin B₃.val B₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  ring

lemma quad_self_proj (T : MSSMACC.Sols) :
    quadBiLin T.val (proj T.1.1).val =
    (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  erw [quadSol T.1]
  rw [quadBiLin.swap T.val Y₃.val, quadBiLin.swap T.val B₃.val]
  ring

lemma quad_proj (T : MSSMACC.Sols) :
    quadBiLin (proj T.1.1).val (proj T.1.1).val = 2 * dot Y₃.val B₃.val *
    ((dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val) := by
  nth_rewrite 1 [proj_val]
  repeat rw [quadBiLin.map_add₁]
  repeat rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₁]
  rw [quad_Y₃_proj, quad_B₃_proj, quad_self_proj]
  ring

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.MSSMNu.LineY3B3
/-!
# The type of solutions perpendicular to `Y₃` and `B₃`

We define the type of solutions which are orthogonal to `Y₃` and `B₃` and prove some basic lemmas
about them.

# References

The main reference for the material in this file is:

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2107.07926.pdf

-/
universe v u

namespace MSSMACC
open MSSMCharges
open MSSMACCs
open BigOperators

/-- The type of linear solutions orthogonal to $Y_3$ and $B_3$. -/
structure AnomalyFreePerp extends MSSMACC.LinSols where
  perpY₃ : dot Y₃.val val = 0
  perpB₃ : dot B₃.val val = 0

/-- The projection of an object in `MSSMACC.AnomalyFreeLinear` onto the subspace
  orthogonal to `Y₃` and`B₃`. -/
def proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) : MSSMACC.AnomalyFreePerp :=
  ⟨(dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) • Y₃.1.1
  + (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) • B₃.1.1
  + dot Y₃.val B₃.val • T,
  by
    change dot _ (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val + _ • T.val) = 0
    rw [dot.map_add₂, dot.map_add₂]
    rw [dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val Y₃.val = 216 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    ring,
  by
    change dot _ (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val + _ • T.val) = 0
    rw [dot.map_add₂, dot.map_add₂]
    rw [dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot B₃.val Y₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot B₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    ring⟩

lemma proj_val (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    (proj T).val = (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) • Y₃.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) • B₃.val +
    dot Y₃.val B₃.val • T.val := by
  rfl

lemma Y₃_plus_B₃_plus_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) (a b c : ℚ) :
    a • Y₃.val + b • B₃.val + c • (proj T).val =
    (a + c * (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val)) • Y₃.val
    + (b + c * (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val)) • B₃.val
    + (dot Y₃.val B₃.val * c) • T.val:= by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [DistribMulAction.smul_add, DistribMulAction.smul_add]
  rw [add_assoc (_ • _ • Y₃.val), ← add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val), add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val)]
  rw [add_comm (_ • B₃.val) (_ • _ • Y₃.val), ← add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val)]
  rw [← MulAction.mul_smul, ← Module.add_smul]
  repeat rw [add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [← add_assoc, ← MulAction.mul_smul, ← Module.add_smul]
  apply congrArg
  simp only [HSMul.hSMul, SMul.smul, MSSMACC_numberCharges, Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceFinMk]
  funext i
  linarith

lemma quad_Y₃_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    quadBiLin Y₃.val (proj T).val = dot Y₃.val B₃.val * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [show quadBiLin Y₃.val B₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  rw [show quadBiLin Y₃.val Y₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  ring

lemma quad_B₃_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    quadBiLin B₃.val (proj T).val = dot Y₃.val B₃.val * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [show quadBiLin B₃.val Y₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  rw [show quadBiLin B₃.val B₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  ring

lemma quad_self_proj (T : MSSMACC.Sols) :
    quadBiLin T.val (proj T.1.1).val =
    (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) * quadBiLin B₃.val T.val := by
  exact?

informal_statement: For a given object \( T \) in a specific mathematical structure, the composition of the linear transformation \( \text{cubeTriLin} \) applied to the projections of \( T \) onto \( Y_3 \) and \( B_3 \), followed by the application of \( B_3 \), is equal to the product of the square of the dot product of \( Y_3 \) and \( B_3 \) with the transformation \( \text{cubeTriLin} \) applied directly to \( T \) and \( B_3 \).
informal_proof:
To establish the stated equality, we proceed as follows:

1. **Given**: Let \( T \) be an arbitrary element in the defined mathematical structure.
2. **Projection and Transformation**: Compute \( \text{cubeTriLin}(\text{proj}_{Y_3}(T), \text{proj}_{B_3}(T), B_3) \), where \( \text{proj}_{Y_3}(T) \) denotes the projection of \( T \) onto \( Y_3 \), and similarly for \( \text{proj}_{B_3}(T) \).
3. **Application of Linearity**: Apply the linearity of the \( \text{cubeTriLin} \) transformation across its first two arguments. This step breaks down the transformation into proportional components relative to the projections.
4. **Dot Product Interaction**: Recognize that the interaction between the projections and the original object can be expressed through the dot product of \( Y_3 \) and \( B_3 \).
5. **Scalar Multiplication**: Factor out the scalar quantity \( (\dot Y_3, B_3)^2 \) from the transformation, highlighting its role in scaling the overall result.
6. **Remaining Transformation**: Observe that after factoring out the scalar, the remaining transformation is equivalent to applying \( \text{cubeTriLin} \) directly to \( T \) and \( B_3 \).
7. **Conclusion**: Combine the scalar factor with the unscaled transformation to obtain the final equality, thereby proving the statement.

Hence, we have demonstrated that 
\[
\text{cubeTriLin}\left(\text{proj}_{Y_3}(T), \text{proj}_{B_3}(T), B_3\right) = (\dot Y_3, B_3)^2 \cdot \text{cubeTriLin}(T, B_3)
\]
as required.

import HepLean.AnomalyCancellation.MSSMNu.LineY3B3
/-!
# The type of solutions perpendicular to `Y₃` and `B₃`

We define the type of solutions which are orthogonal to `Y₃` and `B₃` and prove some basic lemmas
about them.

# References

The main reference for the material in this file is:

- https://arxiv.org/pdf/2107.07926.pdf

-/
universe v u

namespace MSSMACC
open MSSMCharges
open MSSMACCs
open BigOperators

/-- The type of linear solutions orthogonal to $Y_3$ and $B_3$. -/
structure AnomalyFreePerp extends MSSMACC.LinSols where
  perpY₃ : dot Y₃.val val = 0
  perpB₃ : dot B₃.val val = 0

/-- The projection of an object in `MSSMACC.AnomalyFreeLinear` onto the subspace
  orthogonal to `Y₃` and`B₃`. -/
def proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) : MSSMACC.AnomalyFreePerp :=
  ⟨(dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) • Y₃.1.1
  + (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) • B₃.1.1
  + dot Y₃.val B₃.val • T,
  by
    change dot _ (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val + _ • T.val) = 0
    rw [dot.map_add₂, dot.map_add₂]
    rw [dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val Y₃.val = 216 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    ring,
  by
    change dot _ (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val + _ • T.val) = 0
    rw [dot.map_add₂, dot.map_add₂]
    rw [dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂, dot.map_smul₂]
    rw [show dot Y₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot B₃.val Y₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    rw [show dot B₃.val B₃.val = 108 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
    ring⟩

lemma proj_val (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    (proj T).val = (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val) • Y₃.val +
    (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val) • B₃.val +
    dot Y₃.val B₃.val • T.val := by
  rfl

lemma Y₃_plus_B₃_plus_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) (a b c : ℚ) :
    a • Y₃.val + b • B₃.val + c • (proj T).val =
    (a + c * (dot B₃.val T.val - dot Y₃.val T.val)) • Y₃.val
    + (b + c * (dot Y₃.val T.val - 2 * dot B₃.val T.val)) • B₃.val
    + (dot Y₃.val B₃.val * c) • T.val:= by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [DistribMulAction.smul_add, DistribMulAction.smul_add]
  rw [add_assoc (_ • _ • Y₃.val), ← add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val + _ • B₃.val), add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val)]
  rw [add_comm (_ • B₃.val) (_ • _ • Y₃.val), ← add_assoc (_ • Y₃.val)]
  rw [← MulAction.mul_smul, ← Module.add_smul]
  repeat rw [add_assoc]
  apply congrArg
  rw [← add_assoc, ← MulAction.mul_smul, ← Module.add_smul]
  apply congrArg
  simp only [HSMul.hSMul, SMul.smul, MSSMACC_numberCharges, Fin.isValue, Fin.reduceFinMk]
  funext i
  linarith

lemma quad_Y₃_proj (T : MSSMACC.LinSols) :
    quadBiLin Y₃.val (proj T).val = dot Y₃.val B₃.val * quadBiLin Y₃.val T.val := by
  rw [proj_val]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_add₂, quadBiLin.map_add₂]
  rw [quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂, quadBiLin.map_smul₂]
  rw [show quadBiLin Y₃.val B₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  rw [show quadBiLin Y₃.val Y₃.val = 0 by with_unfolding_all rfl]
  ring

/-- The dot product on the vector space of charges. -/
@[simps!]
def dot : BiLinearSymm MSSMCharges.Charges := BiLinearSymm.mk₂
  (fun S => ∑ i, (Q S.1 i * Q S.2 i + U S.1 i * U S.2 i +
    D S.1 i * D S.2 i + L S.1 i * L S.2 i + E S.1 i * E S.2 i
    + N S.1 i * N S.2 i) + Hd S.1 * Hd S.2 + Hu S.1 * Hu S.2)
  (by
    intro a S T
    simp only [MSSMSpecies_numberCharges]
    repeat rw [(toSMSpecies _).map_smul]
    rw [Hd.map_smul, Hu.map_smul]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [HSMul.hSMul, SMul.smul, Fin.isValue, toSMSpecies_apply, Hd_apply, Fin.reduceFinMk,
      Hu_apply]
    ring)
  (by
    intro S1 S2 T
    simp only [MSSMSpecies_numberCharges, toSMSpecies_apply, Fin.isValue,
      ACCSystemCharges.chargesAddCommMonoid_add, map_add, Hd_apply, Fin.reduceFinMk, Hu_apply]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [reduceMul, Fin.isValue, Prod.mk_zero_zero, Prod.mk_one_one]
    ring)
  (by
    intro S T
    simp only [MSSMSpecies_numberCharges, toSMSpecies_apply, Fin.isValue, Hd_apply, Fin.reduceFinMk,
      Hu_apply]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [reduceMul, Fin.isValue, Prod.mk_zero_zero, Prod.mk_one_one]
    ring)

informal_statement: The cube projection of `Y₃.val` applied twice on a specific point results in a value equal to the square of `Y₃.val` projected onto the `dot` product of `Y₃.val` with `B₃.val`, multiplied by the cube triangulation of certain projected values.
informal_proof:
First, consider the cube projection function `proj` which transforms a value `T.val` onto a cube surface. The projection operation is applied twice on the product of `Y₃.val`, yielding a result that involves both `Y₃.val` and `B₃.val`. This operation is then scaled by the square of the dot product between `Y₃.val` and `B₃.val`. The cube triangulation function `cubeTriLin` is applied to these projected values in a way that preserves the linear relationships between the points. 

By leveraging the properties of linear transformations and projective geometry, we derive that the nested projections can be simplified by recognizing they commute with linear combinations and scalar multiplications. This allows us to factor out common terms and apply algebraic simplification to arrive at the result. 

Finally, the properties of associativity and commutativity under projection ensure that the sequence of operations can be rearranged to express the nested projections as a product of scalars and linear transformations, achieving the desired equality.

builtin_dsimproc [simp, seval] reduceFinMk (Fin.mk _ _)  := fun e => do
  let_expr Fin.mk n v _ ← e | return .continue
  let some n ← evalNat n |>.run | return .continue
  let some v ← getNatValue? v | return .continue
  if h : n ≠ 0 then
    have : NeZero n := ⟨h⟩
    return .done <| toExpr (Fin.ofNat' n v)
  else
    return .continue

builtin_dsimproc [simp, seval] isValue ((OfNat.ofNat _ : Fin _)) := fun e => do
  let_expr OfNat.ofNat _ m _ ← e | return .continue
  let some ⟨n, v⟩ ← getFinValue? e | return .continue

/--
Congruence in the function argument: if `a₁ = a₂` then `f a₁ = f a₂` for
any (nondependent) function `f`. This is more powerful than it might look at first, because
you can also use a lambda expression for `f` to prove that
`<something containing a₁> = <something containing a₂>`. This function is used
internally by tactics like `congr` and `simp` to apply equalities inside
subterms.

For more information: [Equality](https://lean-lang.org/theorem_proving_in_lean4/quantifiers_and_equality.html#equality)
-/
theorem congrArg {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} {a₁ a₂ : α} (f : α → β) (h : Eq a₁ a₂) : Eq (f a₁) (f a₂) :=
  h ▸ rfl

  (fun S => ∑ i, (Q S.1 i * Q S.2 i + U S.1 i * U S.2 i +

    simp only [MSSMSpecies_numberCharges]
    repeat rw [(toSMSpecies _).map_smul]
    rw [Hd.map_smul, Hu.map_smul]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    simp only [HSMul.hSMul, SMul.smul, Fin.isValue, toSMSpecies_apply, Hd_apply, Fin.reduceFinMk,

    simp only [reduceMul, Fin.isValue, Prod.mk_zero_zero, Prod.mk_one_one]

    rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_three]

informal_statement: Given a solution \( T \), the projection \( \text{proj}(T) \) is defined by adjusting \( T \) using the dot products with vectors \( Y_3 \) and \( B_3 \). Specifically, it subtracts scaled versions of \( Y_3 \) and \( B_3 \) from \( T \), ensuring that the result is orthogonal to both \( Y_3 \) and \( B_3 \).
informal_proof:
First, we define the projection \( \text{proj}(T) \) as follows:
\[
\text{proj}(T) = \left( \dotprod{B_3}{T} - \dotprod{Y_3}{T} \right) \cdot Y_3.1.1 + \left( \dotprod{Y_3}{T} - 2 \cdot \dotprod{B_3}{T} \right) \cdot B_3.1.1 + \dotprod{Y_3}{B_3} \cdot T
\]
This formula adjusts \( T \) by subtracting components in the directions of \( Y_3 \) and \( B_3 \), effectively removing those components from \( T \).

To show that \( \text{proj}(T) \) lies in the orthogonal subspace, we verify that the dot product of \( \text{proj}(T) \) with any vector in the subspace spanned by \( Y_3 \) and \( B_3 \) is zero. This means that \( \text{proj}(T) \) is orthogonal to both \( Y_3 \) and \( B_3 \).

Therefore, the projection \( \text{proj}(T) \) is orthogonal to the subspace spanned by \( Y_3 \) and \( B_3 \), ensuring that it lies in the orthogonal complement.
